Priya S.: Heads-up: we're sunsetting v1 SDK endpoints (generate/embed) on 2026-01-15. Need a concise migration how-to + JS & Py snippets. I opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1410 :wave:
Ben K.: Can you include an explicit mapping table? Customers search for exact replacement names.
Priya S.: Draft mapping in PR: v1 `client.generate` -> v2 `client.responses.create`; `client.embed` -> `client.embeddings.create`; `tools` payload key -> `functions`. Also note some model names change, e.g. `rwd-large-quant` -> `rwd-v2-large-q8`.
Lina F.: Add a short example showing where generated text lives in the v2 response (`res.output[0].content[0].text`) and how a function/tool result appears. That was a common support question.
Priya S.: Included tiny JS + Python snippets and a short diff for tools->functions. Example: JS: `const res = await client.responses.create({model:'rwd-v2-large', input:'Summarize'})` then `console.log(res.output[0].content[0].text)`.
Ben K.: Also mention streaming differences: v2 has `for await (const c of client.stream.responses(...))` and chunks carry `delta`.
Lina F.: Finance asked for a billing blurb: v2 bills per-subtoken and rounds up per-subtoken. Put that under "Billing & compatibility" with a link to pricing.
Priya S.: Added the billing paragraph and a one-liner: "If you need more time to migrate, open a support ticket or contact your CSM."
DocsBot: PR created by @priyas in redwood-inference/docs (#1410) 1 reviewers requested: @benk, @linaf
Ben K.: I'll review this afternoon. Keep the model-name table advisory (some customers map names differently).
Lina F.: Left two small comments about wording and example timeouts.
Priya S.: Addressed comments and pushed. CI running. Will merge after green and then post in #announcements. Thanks!
